# wow-forever-leveling-guide-addon - WoW Forever Leveling Guide Addon ByJTT

> Free, minimal, data-driven leveling guide for World of Warcraft: Forever. By ByJTT (solo studio).

- Repo: https://github.com/ByJTT/wow-forever-leveling-guide-addon
- Display name (TOC Title, "AddonName ByJTT" style): `WoW Forever Leveling Guide Addon ByJTT`
- In-game addon folder name (critical, must remain stable): `ForeverLevelingGuide`
- Purpose: step-by-step leveling guide panel with minimap access, navigation arrow/manual waypoint, and progress tracking; in-panel guide picker; extensible Lua route data. Guidance UI only (no gameplay automation).
- Target: World of Warcraft: Forever (Interface 16001, 30300). Feature-detected API fallbacks. No Ace/framework deps.
- Install path: `<WoW Forever>/Interface/AddOns/ForeverLevelingGuide/ForeverLevelingGuide.toc`
- Required in-game files: `ForeverLevelingGuide.toc`, `Core.lua`, `GuideEngine.lua`, `Tracker.lua`, `Arrow.lua`, `UI.lua`, `Data/Guides.lua`, and route files in `Data/` listed in TOC. Repo-only: `BYJTT_WOW_ADDON_STANDARD.md` (shared UX/quality conventions), docs/dev/tools files.
- Commands: `/flg show|hide|toggle|config|onboarding|list|load <key>|continue|suggest|next|prev|skip|goto <n>|reset|resetui|resetdefaults|arrow|auto|announce|update|lock|minimap|way|where|debug|debug export|help` (aliases: `/levelguide`, `/journey`, `/jf`). UI includes a **Guides** picker, draggable minimap button, settings panel (`/flg config`, Blizzard UI or fallback), and re-openable welcome guide (`/flg onboarding`). `/flg update` toggles peer version notifications (in-game comms only, no internet/auto-update; use CurseForge/WowUp/Wago when released or repo for actual updates).
- Routes: bundled 1-10 starter samples plus original 10-60 chained scaffold guides (Horde/Alliance, `scaffold=true`, WIP placeholders, `next` links). Engine supports broad step type/field aliases (quest, travel/path/coords arrival, level, collect/item, manual/info) with best-effort auto-advance.
- Guide flow: level/faction-aware auto-selection, guide chaining (`next`) with `/flg continue`, `/flg suggest` and guide-complete next suggestions, navigation arrow, manual waypoint override (`/flg way`), optional best-effort TomTom waypoint integration when installed (no dependency). Scaffold bracket/zone flow compared at a high level to established guides for pacing; step text/structure original/clean-room.
- Verification/authoring aids: `/flg debug export` (copyable in-game state report) and `python tools/validate_guides.py` (offline guide/chain/TOC checks). Keep routes original/clean-room; do not guess real in-game quest IDs/mapIDs/coords (verify on WoW Forever).
- SavedVariables: `ForeverLevelingGuideDB` (schema-versioned, per-character progress/profile, additive manual waypoint/minimap settings).
- Safety: UI/route helper only - no gameplay automation, no protected/secure actions. All route content and engine logic must remain original/open. Canonical addon: `ForeverLevelingGuide` (keep `BYJTT_JourneyFree` as research/prototype only if present).
- Branding/support (public): by ByJTT - https://byjtt.com - https://github.com/ByJTT - Support placeholder: https://buymeacoffee.com/ByJTT (replace with real URL when ready).
- Issues: include WoW Forever build/interface, addon version (`/flg debug`), guide key/step, steps, expected/actual, Lua errors (`/console scriptErrors 1`). No account data/local personal paths.
- License: MIT.
- See also: `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.
